scenes.tts: A young neuron grows more branches than it keeps. Who decides which branch goes?
scenes.visual: Title card: Where Support Is Lost. One sympathetic neuron with many branches reaching a target; NGF dots at the target.
scenes.narration: A young neuron grows more branches than it keeps. Who decides which branch goes?

scenes.tts: Pruning removes an axon branch, or a dendrite, from a neuron that survives.
scenes.visual: One branch fades away; the cell body and the other branches stay. Label: pruning, the neuron survives.
scenes.narration: Pruning removes an axon branch, or a dendrite, from a neuron that survives.

scenes.tts: Development first builds a rough draft, then carves it. Think of a sculptor who piles up too much clay.
scenes.visual: A rough lump of clay is carved into a figure, beside a neuron losing extra branches.
scenes.narration: Development first builds a rough draft, then carves it. Think of a sculptor who piles up too much clay.

scenes.tts: Sympathetic neurons need N G F, a growth factor supplied by their target.
scenes.caption: Sympathetic neurons need NGF, a growth factor supplied by their target.
scenes.visual: Label: NGF, nerve growth factor, a trophic factor supplied by the target. NGF dots drift from the target to the axon tips.
scenes.narration: Sympathetic neurons need NGF, a growth factor supplied by their target.

scenes.tts: Now grow them in a dish divided into compartments. The cell bodies sit in one compartment.
scenes.visual: Campenot's divided dish from above: a central compartment with cell bodies; side compartments around it.
scenes.narration: Now grow them in a dish divided into compartments. The cell bodies sit in one compartment.

scenes.tts: Their branches cross into side compartments. The fluids stay apart, so each compartment can have N G F, or not.
scenes.caption: Their branches cross into side compartments. The fluids stay apart, so each compartment can have NGF, or not.
scenes.visual: Branches of one neuron cross barriers into two side compartments, each filled with NGF dots. Credit: Campenot, 1977 and 1982.
scenes.narration: Their branches cross into side compartments. The fluids stay apart, so each compartment can have NGF, or not.

scenes.tts: Remove N G F from one side compartment only. Which branches degenerate?
scenes.caption: Remove NGF from one side compartment only. Which branches degenerate?
scenes.visual: The NGF dots drain from one side compartment. The branches there are highlighted, waiting.
scenes.narration: Remove NGF from one side compartment only. Which branches degenerate?

scenes.tts: Only the branches in that compartment. Branches of the same neuron next door, still in N G F, stay.
scenes.caption: Only the branches in that compartment. Branches of the same neuron next door, still in NGF, stay.
scenes.visual: The deprived branches break into pieces; the same neuron's branches in the other compartment stay intact.
scenes.narration: Only the branches in that compartment. Branches of the same neuron next door, still in NGF, stay.

scenes.tts: Now remove N G F from every compartment. What happens to the neuron?
scenes.caption: Now remove NGF from every compartment. What happens to the neuron?
scenes.visual: All compartments drain of NGF dots. The cell body is highlighted.
scenes.narration: Now remove NGF from every compartment. What happens to the neuron?

scenes.tts: The neuron dies, and its axons go with it.
scenes.visual: The cell body shrinks and fades, and every branch fragments.
scenes.narration: The neuron dies, and its axons go with it.

scenes.tts: Here is the one idea for this lesson. Where support is lost decides what is lost.
scenes.visual: Rule card: Where support is lost decides what is lost.
scenes.narration: Here is the one idea for this lesson. Where support is lost decides what is lost.

scenes.tts: Lose support at the axons while the cell body keeps it, and the axons degenerate while the neuron lives.
scenes.visual: Rule card adds: the axons lose support while the cell body keeps it, the axons go, the neuron lives.
scenes.narration: Lose support at the axons while the cell body keeps it, and the axons degenerate while the neuron lives.

scenes.tts: Lose it everywhere, and the neuron dies.
scenes.visual: Rule card adds: the whole neuron loses support, the neuron dies.
scenes.narration: Lose it everywhere, and the neuron dies.

scenes.tts: In the animal, target N G F normally reaches the cell body through signals sent back along the axons.
scenes.visual: A neuron in the body: NGF taken up at the axon tips sends a signal back to the distant cell body. Label: the main route of target-derived support.
scenes.narration: In the animal, target NGF normally reaches the cell body through signals sent back along the axons.
scenes.caption: In the animal, target NGF normally reaches the cell body through signals sent back along the axons.

scenes.tts: So pruning and death follow the same rule. But they share enzymes, and are wired differently.
scenes.visual: Two panels side by side: one branch lost; one whole neuron lost. Label: same rule, differently wired routes.
scenes.narration: So pruning and death follow the same rule. But they share enzymes, and are wired differently.

scenes.tts: Both use caspases, the enzymes of cell death. So how can one branch use them, and the neuron live?
scenes.visual: Scissors icons labelled caspases appear in both panels, with a question mark over the branch panel.
scenes.narration: Both use caspases, the enzymes of cell death. So how can one branch use them, and the neuron live?

scenes.tts: This rule covers branches lost after support is lost. Some branches go on a fixed program instead. Those come later.
scenes.visual: Scope note on screen: covers pruning after lost support; stereotyped pruning, on a program, comes later.
scenes.narration: This rule covers branches lost after support is lost. Some branches go on a fixed program instead. Those come later.

scenes.tts: So to predict what is lost, first ask where the support was lost.
scenes.visual: Closing card: to predict what is lost, ask where support was lost.
scenes.narration: So to predict what is lost, first ask where the support was lost.
